title: tbnnFoam: OpenFOAM C++ In-Solver Tensor Basis Neural Network RANS Closure
description:
tbnnFoam is an open-source in-situ coupled Reynolds-Averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) solver within OpenFOAM featuring a dual-runtime inference architecture: an embedded LibTorch C++ engine and a zero-dependency standalone C++ matrix evaluator with an analytical Cardano cubic eigensolver that enforces physical realizability on the Lumley triangle in O(1) operations per cell.

This software release archives the complete source code, pre-trained neural network weights, LibTorch and native C++ inference backends, automated verification test suite with synthetic fixtures, canonical square duct benchmark specifications (Pirozzoli et al., J. Fluid Mech. 2018), and full OpenFOAM verification cases for developing square duct flow at Re_b = 4,410 and Re_b = 17,800.

Features cross-engine numerical parity across PyTorch, TorchScript, and standalone C++ (within 10⁻⁵), exact Boussinesq-limit momentum assembly consistency (relative deviation 3.6 × 10⁻¹⁷), and independent algorithmic vortex detection recovering Prandtl's eight secondary recirculation cells.
